profile.headline: Building Voltage's new frontend
profile.summary: I'm a frontend developer with a major Rust hobby. I learned to code after a career in tech journalism. I still love writing, but it's important to me to build things not just talk about them.

positions.title: React Native Developer
positions.description: I helped maintain a legacy React Native app while working on a ground up rewrite using a more modern style. The app is designed for small communities to stay in touch and up to date. I touched every part of the app from API to UI and fought many battles with React Native, including a major upgrade in versions.

positions.title: Digital pressman
positions.description: I was the main operator / technician of two digital presses.

positions.title: Potato Grader / Sampler
positions.description: I sampled / graded potatoes for a summer and got a great tan.

positions.title: Web designer
positions.description: My dad's design shop. I was the guy who pretended to know how to make websites, and I also did a lot of other random tasks like tech support and map drawing.

projects.title: My Own Personal Blog (a static site generator in Rust)

publications.title: I’m still here: back online after a year without the internet
